system.creatureSubtype: immune to poison, disease, exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Unconscious; immune to lightning damage; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.tactics: Elder Stormcallers command battlefields from altitude, using Storm Presence to slow enemy movement while delivering Chain Lightning to clustered targets. They descend for Wind Blade strikes when softening up isolated threats. A Friendly Elder Stormcaller is a genuine tactical partner; even an Indifferent one tends to find the most dramatic target and hammer it.
system.attacksNotes:
Wind Blade [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (9 + 5 Str) + 4 lightning damage.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; target pushed 15 feet.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; target pushed 15 feet and Stunned until end of their next turn.

Chain Lightning [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 6 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft, up to 4 targets. Targets must be within 30 ft of each other

  • Margin 1:: 18 lightning damage (12 + 6 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up).
  • Margin 3: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Storm Presence: When the Elder Stormcaller takes its turn, all creatures within 30 feet must make a Fortitude [Easy] save or have their movement speed halved until the start of their next turn. Momentum Defense: While it has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Eye of the Storm: Allies the Stormcaller designates are immune to Storm Presence's effects. Lightning Immunity Aura: Creatures the Stormcaller designates as protected gain resistance to lightning damage (+4 DR) while within 30 feet. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Stormcaller fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
